reasoning: The UNSC has been active on Sudan, adopting Resolution 2736 (June 2024) and Resolution 2791 (September 2025). The sanctions regime was extended until October 2026, so no renewal is needed before May 2026. Russia vetoed a ceasefire resolution in November 2024, showing divisions. However, the humanitarian crisis is severe and ongoing. The Council could adopt resolutions on humanitarian access, civilian protection, or other conflict-related matters. Given past activity and the crisis severity, but considering Russian veto risk for substantive measures, I estimate moderate-high probability.
